name: Brick-or-Treat at LEGOLAND California
summary: Brick-or-Treat is LEGOLAND California's daytime, family-focused Halloween event on 12 select dates in 2026, with costumes, LEGO monsters, treat activities and shows. It is included with a dated park ticket; some annual-pass tiers need a paid event ticket.
h1: Brick-or-Treat at LEGOLAND California: the family Halloween, priced and judged
title: Brick-or-Treat LEGOLAND California
description: Brick-or-Treat at LEGOLAND California: confirmed 2026 dates, family activities and which park tickets or annual passes include the event.

typicalWindow.hours: During park hours on selected event dates; check the park calendar

notes: Brick-or-Treat is included with a regular date-specific theme park ticket on an event date.
Premium and Elite annual passes include the event; holders of some other annual-pass tiers need to buy a dated Brick-or-Treat ticket.
Check the official ticket page for current pass eligibility and checkout prices.

whatYouGet: Costume-friendly days where dressing up is the norm, not the exception — the point for the target age.
Brick-built Halloween decor and characters at the scale only Legoland builds.
Treat stations and trails sized to grade-school legs and attention spans.
Family entertainment and the new Brick or Treat Street on scheduled event dates.
whatYouDont: Scares, in any form — this is the deliberate anti-haunt, and that is its entire value.
A separate nighttime party ticket with regular admission; the published 2026 event is part of selected park days.
A late-night adult haunt; the published program is built for families.

verdict.short: Worth considering for families who want a playful Halloween park day with costumes and treats; first check that your selected date and ticket cover the event.
worthItIf: Your kids want to wear costumes at a theme park and collect treats at kid scale.
You want the Halloween season without the scare-actor exposure of every other event here.
A scheduled event day fits your trip and you already want to visit LEGOLAND.
skipIf: Anyone in the party wants scares — the event has none, and that is a feature.
Your annual pass tier needs a separate event ticket and the extra cost does not suit your plans.
Your kids are over about ten — the target bracket is young and the event scales to it.

strategy.heading: Match the date to your ticket
body: In 2026, Brick-or-Treat runs September 19 and 26; October 3–4, 10–11, 17–18, 24–25 and 31; and November 1. A regular ticket for an event date includes the celebration. Premium and Elite passholders also have access, while several other pass tiers require a separate dated event ticket.

strategy.heading: The costume rules
body: Costumes are welcomed here unlike at most big parks — check the park's event page for the current guidelines on masks and accessories, which are real rules enforced gently. The character photo ops are the event's best souvenir and they are better in costume.

strategy.heading: Timing with the age bracket
body: The event is built around young families and short legs. Check that the park is open on your chosen event date, do favorite rides earlier in the day, and use the park's event guide for treat trails, shows and character times.

faqs.a: No — that is the product. Zero scare actors, zero haunted anything; Halloween as decoration and candy for the young-kid bracket. It is the deliberate counterweight to every other event on this site.

A regular date-specific LEGOLAND California ticket includes Brick-or-Treat on a scheduled 2026 event date. Premium and Elite annual passes include it; several other pass tiers require an additional dated event ticket. Check your pass terms before visiting.
The 2026 event dates are September 19 and 26; October 3–4, 10–11, 17–18, 24–25 and 31; and November 1. These are selected days, not every day in the date range.

faqs.q: What ages is it best for?
faqs.a: Roughly three to ten, matching the park itself. Costumed kids at the younger end get the most from it; kids over ten are past the treat-trail demographic.
